title: Platform diagnostics pack v1 — the diagnosis layer of platform_heuristics
description: One pack per ad/commerce platform. Feeds the diagnose_and_recommend family: driver_graphs are the LEGAL factor decompositions a diagnosis cause_node may use (decomposition.method=factor); localization lists the dimensional splits (method=dimensional); data_artifacts are the machine-checkable data_quality.checks that must run BEFORE causes are asserted (their `check` names are the vocabulary of diagnosis_result.data_quality.checks[].name); simulation_levers source simulation assumptions (source=platform_heuristic, ref='<platform>/diagnostics#<path>'). NAME AUTHORITY: every metric/dimension name is a catalog concept/dimension/grain key — the catalog (meerkats-catalog) is the single name source; anything the catalog does not carry is flagged not_in_catalog with a note, never silently invented. ci/check_diagnostics.py enforces this against generated/catalog.json.

efficiency.description: The platform's headline efficiency metric — what diagnosis roots on and recommendation optimizes unless told otherwise.

display_label.description: native label, per the dictionary pack

items.description: A multiplicative identity the diagnosis planner may decompose along (cause_node.decomposition = {method: factor, additive: false} — attribute via LMDI/log).

localization.description: Legal dimensional splits (cause_node.decomposition = {method: dimensional, additive: true}) and the default investigation order.

items.description: A pipeline/platform artifact that mimics a real movement. Diagnosis runs these as data_quality.checks BEFORE asserting causes; `check` is the checks[].name vocabulary.

mimics.description: the false story this artifact tells

applies_to.description: catalog concepts whose movements it can fake

severity.description: blocker: withhold the cause tree (status data_quality_blocked); warn: proceed, label

items.description: Real-world causes (cause_node.kind=external) and where their evidence lives.

source.description: pack or table that carries the evidence

parked_concepts.description: catalog concepts with status no_data that would evidence this once ingested

items.description: Account-structure preconditions (from the structure pack) to test before per-entity reasoning — one structural cause explains many entities at once.

Lever→response beliefs for the simulation task type, and whether the lever is even bindable here (mirrors the capability registry — a lever that is unavailable makes any recommendation using it advisory).

operation.description: query_and_act operation types only — a lever must be expressible as an operation

recommendation_notes.description: Platform truths every recommendation must respect; automation_guards in capabilities remain authoritative for execution.
